summary: This class configures the "DeepFriedNosh" food item in Oxygen Not Included. It inherits from `IEntityConfig` and `IHasDlcRestrictions`, indicating it's a configurable entity requiring DLC management. The class defines the creation and initialization of the DeepFriedNosh prefab, specifying its name, description, animation, collision shape, and other relevant attributes.  It also includes a `recipe` which is likely used to define how this food item is created. This suggests it's a mod-added food item, likely part of DLC2, considering its use of `DlcManager.DLC2`.

keyMethods.description: Returns an array of DLC IDs required for this entity.  In this case, it specifies DLC2, meaning the DeepFriedNosh is only available if DLC2 is enabled.

keyMethods.name: GetForbiddenDlcIds
keyMethods.description: Returns an array of DLC IDs that prevent this entity from existing.  This returns `null`, indicating no DLCs prevent its existence.

It sets the name, description, mass, animation, collision, and assigns it to the `FOOD.FOOD_TYPES.DEEP_FRIED_NOSH` type.
